$description: Appearance-invariant base tokens and press-scale override for the shadcn neutral theme.

designMd.overview: shadcn/ui's neutral palette paired with flat surfaces (`state.press-scale: 1`) and Tailwind-style border/shadow lifts (`references/shadcn-ui` `new-york-v4`).
designMd.elevation: Flat elevation model: cards and floating surfaces sit on neutral background steps with subtle drop shadows and crisp 1px borders rather than inner specular highlights or glass blur.
dos: Keep press interactions flat (`state.press-scale: 1`); signal hover and press via surface and opacity changes.
Preserve the 31 shadcn A-layer color slots (`background`, `foreground`, `card`, `primary`, `secondary`, `muted`, `accent`, `destructive`, `border`, `input`, `ring`, `chart-1..5`, `sidebar*`).
donts: Do not add backdrop blur, specular rim highlights, or press shrink to flat shadcn finishes.

radius.$description: Base corner radius scale referenced by semantic shape roles.

control.$description: Corner radius for in-page controls, fields, rows, chips, badges, wells, color areas, and kbd.

container.$description: Corner radius for cards, menus, popovers, tooltips, list panels, toasts, and frames.

modal.$description: Corner radius for dialogs, sheets, and drawers.

corner.$description: A badge's corner: the control radius, `full` for a capsule, or points.

face.$description: The ground a chosen control turns over to: a toggle that is on, a tool that is picked, a button that is selected.

ink.$description: What a chosen control's label and glyph are drawn in.

edge.$description: What a destructive button's edge is drawn in, or `none` where it draws none.

color.$description: What a field's focus edge and ring are drawn in (`color:brand` for a crisp accent ring, `color:ring` for the theme's `focus.style` halo).

highlight.$description: What a listbox or command option's focused background is drawn in (`tint:brand`, `color:accent`).

edge.$description: What a listbox option's focused border is drawn in (`color:brand@0.3`, `none`).

corner.$description: A popup's surface corner (a menu's, a select's list, a calendar's): `container` is the theme's `shape.container`.

face.$description: What a tooltip bubble is filled with.

ink.$description: What a tooltip bubble's text is drawn in.

edge.$description: What a tooltip bubble's border is drawn in, or `none` where it draws none.

shade.$description: The finish whose elevation shadow a tooltip bubble wears, or `none`.

edge.$description: What a tab strip's track edge is drawn in, or `none` where it draws no border.

corner.$description: A tab strip's track corner: `full` for a capsule, `control`, or points.
A choice's corner, per input: a quarter of its box where it is a square, half of it where it is a circle.

shade.$description: The finish whose shade an unchosen box wears, or `none`.

face.$description: The layer a chosen radio turns over to, or `none` where it keeps its ground and draws a ring and dot.
What a slider's rail is filled with.

shade.$description: The finish whose shade a slider's rail wears, or `none`.

color.$description: What a slider's rail edge is drawn in, or `none` where it draws none.

width.$description: How thick a slider's rail edge is; `control` is the theme's `stroke.control`.

size.$description: A slider's knob, per input: diameter or `[width, height]` (`0` where the theme draws only a mark).

pressed.$description: The knob size while pressed, per input, or `same` to keep the resting knob size.

edge.$description: What a solid slider knob's border is drawn in, or `none` where it wears only the knob finish's own edge.

track.$description: An off switch's track, per input: `[width, height]`.
A small switch's track, per input: `[width, height]`.

off.$description: How thick an off switch's track edge is.

on.$description: How thick an on switch's track edge is.

color.$description: What an off switch's track edge is drawn in, or `none` where the track has no border.
Appearance-invariant C-layer color roles shared by light and dark modes.

scrim.$description: Translucent backdrop scrim behind modals and sheets (50% black).

media.$description: Ground behind photographs and videos; invariant across appearances.

on-media.$description: White ink over photographs and dark media surfaces; invariant across appearances.

state.$description: Interaction state opacities and press scale.

press-scale.$description: Scale factor applied while pressed (1 disables press shrinking for flat shadcn surfaces).
